'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!}}

==Objectives==
* Find 5 [[Disposable syringe]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Disposable syringe|items]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Pile of meds]]
{{quote|Were you able to find them? Excellent, I'll begin administering the vaccines tomorrow.}}
